highlights.headline: EU emissions continue to fall as clean energy gains ground
highlights.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 09 Nov 2026 The European Commission has today published the 2026 EU Climate Action Progress Report and Carbon Market Report, showing that EU greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions continue to fall, clean technologies are expanding, and an increasing amount of ETS revenues are available to EU Member States for investments in decarbonisation.

items.title: EU aims to pick new ECB chief by year-end
